test_col_simple: test pd.col() expression with arithmetic operators like add, multiply, subtract, divide, power, and modulo
test_inplace_ops: test pd.col() expression with inplace operators like iadd, isub, imul, itruediv, ipow, and bitwise ops
test_matmul: test pd.col() expression with matrix multiplication using @ operator against a list
test_frame_getitem: test pd.col() boolean expression used as a filter in DataFrame __getitem__ indexing
test_frame_setitem: test pd.col() boolean expression used as a mask in DataFrame __setitem__ assignment
test_frame_loc: test pd.col() boolean expression used as row selector in DataFrame .loc accessor
test_frame_iloc: test pd.col() boolean expression used as row selector in DataFrame .iloc accessor
test_namespaces: test pd.col() expression with .dt and .str accessor namespaces for datetime and string operations
test_col_logical_ops: test pd.col() expression with logical operators and, or, xor, and not on boolean columns
test_expression_getitem: test pd.col() expression with bracket indexing to extract a scalar value
test_property: test pd.col() expression accessing .index property to retrieve column index values
test_cached_property: test pd.col() expression accessing .index.dtype cached property to retrieve dtype
test_qcut: test pd.col() expression passed to pd.qcut() for quantile-based binning
test_where: test pd.col() expression with .where() method for conditional value selection
test_invalid: test pd.col() raises ValueError with helpful column name suggestions for invalid column references
